Questions.answer: It creates a serious electrical hazard for people working in the vicinity.
options: It creates a serious electrical hazard during training sessions.
It creates a serious electrical hazard for people working in the vicinity.
It causes a problem for the open panel cover.

Questions.question: What was the main problem with the power cables?
Questions.answer: They had a smaller conductor size than specified.
options: They were shorter than required for the installation.
They had a smaller conductor size than specified.

Questions.question: What mistake did the trainee make when selecting the cable?
Questions.answer: He failed to verify the current rating against the diagram.
options: He ignored the wiring diagram completely.
He checked the rating but chose a different cable type.
He failed to verify the current rating against the diagram.

Questions.question: Why is leaving tools near a live testing point dangerous?
Questions.answer: It increases the risk of accidental contact and electric shock.
options: It increases the risk of accidental contact of insulated tools.
It increases the risk of accidental contact and electric shock.
It prevents good housekeeping and safe electrical practices.

Questions.question: Which response best reflects professional acceptance of an apology in a workshop context?
Questions.answer: “I’ve heard your explanation. Please correct it and follow the procedure.”
options: “I’ve heard your explanation. Please correct it and follow the procedure.”
“That excuse is not acceptable under any circumstances.”
“I understand and this issue will be ignored for now.”
